# Use Notion AI to write better, more efficient notes and docs

## Learn how to use your Notion Agent to transform text, automate simple tasks, and generate new content inside your connected workspace.

Notion Agent is a connected assistant that helps you think bigger, work faster, and augments your creativity, right inside the functional workspace you’re already familiar with.

If your day to day involves reading docs, writing content, or taking notes, your Notion Agent can make you more efficient. There’s no need to bounce between tools to improve writing or extract insights. Plus, you don’t need to waste time on formatting, formalities, or straightforward text generation, helping you lean into the highest priority tasks in your day.

Your Notion Agent helps you write, edit, summarize, and find answers using the context from your page, your workspace, connected apps, and the web.

You can access your Notion Agent in a few different ways, depending on what you're trying to do:

To ask questions or run a task across your workspace, open the
Notion agent from the sidebar or the bottom corner of your screen. Ask it to summarize the current page, find something across Notion and connected tools like Slack or Google Drive, or take a multi-step task from start to finish.

To improve existing content, highlight the text and select
Edit with AI. Give it a prompt like fix grammar, make it shorter, or change the tone, then accept, discard, or ask it to try again.

To draft or generate new text, press the
space key on a new line and enter a prompt. Notion AI writes directly on the page, and you can @-mention pages, people, and dates to give it context.

In this guide, we'll explore practical ways to use these three actions to improve how you write, read, and edit documents.

Sometimes it's easy to get your ideas onto the page, but turning those thoughts into something polished enough to share with your team or the world can take much longer. Your Notion Agent can help you move from rough notes to a well-structured document in minutes. Here are a few ways to get started:

Write bullet points, have Notion Agent do the rest — job descriptions, performance reviews, and so much more. Write a list of requirements or accomplishments, then ask your Agent to “create a paragraph covering this content” or “make this sound more professional.”

Identify key insights faster — Use your Notion Agent to surface the most important information in a document, making it easier to understand the content at a glance. Try prompts like "create a list of the key takeaways," "summarize this in bullet points," or "organize this information into a table."

Analyze large sets of text — Whether you're reviewing customer feedback, survey responses, meeting notes, or support tickets, your Notion Agent can help you quickly spot patterns without reading every response. Highlight the text and ask your Agent to "identify the five most common themes," "summarize the overall sentiment," or "count how many times a specific request is mentioned."
...
Not sure what to ask your Notion Agent? Here's a few things to try:

Create a list of bullet points with important items

Summarize this information in a table

Pull out common themes from this data

Your Notion Agent can quickly transform existing content to fit the task at hand, without the need to manually rewrite or reformat it. Whether you're adjusting the tone, translating text, or refining your writing, here are a few ways it can help:

Adapt tone of writing — the way you explain a project to peers might not be the right way to phrase something to an executive, even if the content is more or less the same. Take an existing draft or stream of consciousness paragraph, and ask your Notion Agent to “make this more professional,” or “summarize key points as an overview.”

Translate content into another language — if you’re working with a global team or global clients, you understand how time-consuming translation can be. Start with some text, submit a request in another app, wait a few days, then paste translated content back where you started. With Notion Agent you can generate quick, accurate translations between many languages, right where you’re doing the rest of your work.

Get synonyms and define words — whether you’re reading a complex doc and need to quickly define words, or writing one and trying to find the right phrase to capture your thoughts, Notion AI can help. Get your thoughts on the page in whatever form they come to you, then simply highlight a selection of text and select an option from the dropdown.

No matter how you're using your Notion Agent, the quality of the output depends on the quality of your prompt. The more specific and detailed your instructions, the more useful the response will be. We even asked Notion Agent for its own advice on writing better prompts (...

A IA do Notion é um assistente conectado que ajuda você a ampliar seus horizontes, acelerar seu trabalho e expandir sua criatividade, dentro do espaço de trabalho funcional que você já conhece bem.

Se, no seu dia a dia, você lê documentos, escreve conteúdo ou faz anotações, a IA do Notion pode ajudar você a ser mais produtivo. Você não precisa ficar alternando entre ferramentas diferentes para melhorar textos ou ter insights. Você também não precisa perder tempo com formatação, formalidades ou a geração de textos simples. A IA do Notion ajuda você a se concentrar nas prioridades do seu dia.
...
## Como usar a IA do Notion

A IA do Notion produz respostas em texto com base nas perguntas dos usuários e no contexto da página.

Você tem três maneiras de usar a IA do Notion, dependendo das suas necessidades do momento.

Para melhorar o conteúdo existente, destaque o texto e selecione Pedir à IA. Em seguida, escolha uma opção no menu suspenso ou escreva um enunciado personalizado.

Para gerar um resumo ou obter insights de uma página, digite
/IA para visualizar os blocos de IA ou peça à IA do Notion para escrever alguma coisa para você. 

Para escrever um novo texto, use a tecla de
espaço em uma nova página ou linha e insira um enunciado.

Neste guia, vamos mostrar algumas das maneiras como esses três métodos podem melhorar suas experiências escrevendo, lendo e editando documentos.
...
## Ganhe eficiência

A IA é muitas vezes tida como uma ferramenta para gerar informações a partir de um enunciado. A IA do Notion é capaz de muitas coisas, mas sua verdadeira habilidade está em organizar as ideias que você já iniciou e torná-las ainda mais valiosas.

Destaque o texto epeça à IA para fazer qualquer coisa que tire das suas costas tarefas demoradas que a IA do Notion pode fazer em segundos: extrair itens de ação de notas de reunião, obter insights de anotações de pesquisa de clientes e até gerar traduções de alta qualidade.

### Reuniões descomplicadas

Fazer resumos de notas bagunçadas para os outros (ou para você ler no futuro) pode ser algo demorado e chato. Você sabe o que falou, eles sabem o que você falou, mas alguém ainda precisa anotar. Um dia isso foi assim. Agora a IA do Notion faz isso por você.

Blocos especiais de IA, como resumir, itens de ação e conteúdo personalizado, usam o poder da IA do Notion somado ao contexto da página onde são implementados para criar conteúdo 100% personalizado que você não tem como gerar em nenhum outro lugar. Além disso, eles podem ser incorporados em modelos de base de dados como um elemento padrão do seu processo de reunião.

Três “blocos avançados” usam recursos de IA.

Recapitule com
/resumir — crie um resumo executivo em segundos. A IA do Notion usa o contexto do seu documento para gerar frases que resumem o documento inteiro.

Extraia itens de ação com
/itens de ação — não importa se você está analisando a transcrição de uma ligação ou tomando notas com pressa, a IA do Notion pode ajudar a lembrar o que você precisa fazer em seguida.

Escreva qualquer coisa com o
/bloco de IA personalizado - peça à IA do Notion para expandir um pensamento descrito na página ou refutar seu argumento principal. Em vez de começar do zero, esse bloco usa o que está na página para produzir uma resposta, levando a um resultado mais útil.

Use blocos de IA em modelos de base de dados

Se na sua rotina de reuniões, você usa modelos de base de dados para estruturar agendas ou estimular discussões, tente adicionar blocos de IA a eles para automatizar tarefas de acompanhamento em equipe.

### Mais tempo tendo ideias, menos tempo formatando

Colocar ideias no papel é fácil, mas formatar esses pensamentos em um documento apresentável e compartilhar com sua equipe ou com o mundo pode levar horas. Com a IA do Notion, você transforma notas desconexas em documentos finais com rapidez. Veja agora algumas maneiras de fazer isso em seu espaço de trabalho:

Escreva os tópicos e deixe o resto com a IA — descrições de cargos, análises de desempenho e muito mais. Escreva uma lista de requisitos ou realizações e peça à IA para “criar um parágrafo abordando esse conteúdo” ou “dar um tom mais profissional”.

# 什么是 Notion AI？

## Notion AI 已集成到你的 Notion 工作空间中，让你只需点击一下即可解锁知识并完成任务 🤖
...
Notion AI 是你内置的个性化团队成员。无需在 Notion 和其他工具之间来回切换——Notion AI 与你的项目方案、任务以及你存储在 Notion 中的所有内容处于同一地点，它还能搜索你已关联的应用中的信息。
...
概括而言，Notion AI 可以执行以下操作。
...
为你承担整个任务，并通过 Notion 代理 与你对话。你的 Notion 代理可以利用你工作空间和已关联应用的上下文来创建和编辑页面及数据库。
...
通过 AI 区块 帮助你在页面行内优化写作，或在页面中生成自定义输出。
...
它可以从头到尾承担任务，查看你的工作空间和已关联的应用，甚至代表你在工作空间中创建或编辑内容（页面、数据库、图表等）。
...
无论你是在撰写初稿还是编辑现有页面，Notion AI 都能帮你。它甚至能基于你工作空间中的上下文为你生成内容——只需在查询中 @提及特定的页面或人员即可。

你可以高亮显示页面中的文本，或在页面中按下空格键，让 Notion AI 执行以下操作：

对页面进行编辑，例如添加摘要或翻译页面内容。

通过修正语法、增加或缩减内容长度、更改语气等方式，审阅并编辑页面的特定部分。

创建新内容，例如大纲、邮件草稿或表格。

针对特定主题进行头脑风暴。

当 Notion AI 为你创建或编辑内容时，你可以选择接受这些更改、放弃这些更改，或者让 Notion AI 再试一次。

### AI 区块

你可以让 Notion AI 为整个区块赋能。在页面中输入/AI 区块，并向 Notion AI 提供关于它应生成内容的（文字）指令。这可以是自定义输出、你当前页面的摘要，或是当前页面的要点。

如果你需要自定义输出，请尽可能多地向 Notion AI 提供信息，描述其应生成的内容。使用 @提及 功能引用人员、页面和日期。你还可以点击“指定上下文”下的字段，选择 Notion 工作空间及任何已连接应用中的内容，让 Notion AI 主要基于这些内容来生成信息。在“搜索”下，选择你希望 Notion AI 在生成内容时考虑的其他来源。

在 AI 区块上选择“完成”→“生成”即可基于你选择的输出生成内容。你可以随时继续使用同一个 AI 区块——只需点击“生成”即可刷新内容！你还可以通过点击区块内的滑块图标来编辑 AI 区块的设置。
...
前往页面顶部的“•••”→“翻译”，Notion AI 会将页面翻译为你所需的语言。你也可以与智能助手开启对话，并选择“翻译此页面”。

results.summary:
## What Notion AI Actually Is

Notion AI is a built-in assistant inside the Notion workspace. It is not a separate product you install. It runs against the page or block you have open, using a large language model that Notion licenses from a third party. The specific model is not always disclosed publicly, which is worth knowing if model selection matters to you.

Three things make it different from a generic chatbot tab open in your browser.

First, it has access to whatever is on the current page. When you invoke it, the page contents become the prompt context. You can select a subset of blocks or feed it the full page, depending on the action you choose.

Second, it can write back into the page. Outputs are inserted as Notion blocks, not pasted as plain text. Lists become real toggleable lists. Tables become real database rows. This is a small detail that compounds in a real workflow because the output is now queryable, filterable, and linked.

Third, it has access to connectors for external sources. In the current version, you can point Notion AI at Slack, Google Drive, GitHub and a handful of other services. When you ask a question, it can pull from those sources as part of the context. This is a meaningful capability and it is the part most people skip past in setup.

What it is not: it is not the Notion API. The Notion REST API at api.notion.com lets you read and write pages and databases from code. That API has no equivalent endpoint for Notion AI features in the same form. If you want programmatic access to an underlying model, you need a different product.

## Setup and Authentication

There is no API key to manage for Notion AI itself. The setup is workspace configuration and per-user activation.
...
- Go to Settings and members, then the Plans or Billing section.
- Enable Notion AI as an add-on. Pricing is per seat, in the range you would expect for a productivity add-on, billed through your existing Notion plan.
- Confirm that AI features are turned on at the workspace level. There is a master toggle that admins control.

Individual user path:

- Open any page in the workspace.
- On a new line, press the spacebar, or click the sparkle icon in the block menu.
- The AI menu appears. First time, you will be prompted to accept terms and confirm the add-on.
- Choose what context to send: just the current page, the page plus linked subpages, or specific selected blocks.

For external integrations that you might want to combine with Notion AI, you still use the Notion API:

- Create an internal integration at notion.so/my-integrations.
- Copy the integration token. In the current version it begins with ntn_ or secret_.
- Share specific pages or databases with the integration from the Notion UI.
- Use the token as a Bearer token in HTTP calls. Base URL is https://api.notion.com/v1/.

Keep these two systems separate in your head. Notion AI is a UI feature. The Notion API is a developer surface. They do not currently expose the same model the same way.

## First Working Example

A clean first run is a meeting notes summarization. This is the use case Notion AI handles most predictably, and it gives you a feel for how context flows.

Steps:

- Create a new page called something like “Team Sync 2026-06-26”.
- Paste in a long block of raw meeting notes. Real speech, half-sentences, the works.
- Place the cursor on a new line below the notes.
- Press space to invoke AI.
- From the menu, choose Summarize.
- When prompted, confirm the context as “current page”.
- The output appears as a Notion block below your notes.

What you should see is a short structured summary with key decisions, action items, and open questions. The exact format varies, but it is usually a heading plus bulleted lists.
...
8. Highlight the original notes. 9. Press space, choose “Find action items”. 10. The output is a checklist. Each item becomes a real Notion to-do block, which means you can tick them off in place and they roll up if the page is inside a database.

This second step is the more important one. The action items are now real Notion objects. You can drag them into a project database, assign owners via @mentions, or filter them in a view. That round trip from unstructured text to structured data is the core productivity move.

If you want to push further, ask for a follow-up: “Turn these action items into a database with columns...

# AI转型最成功的互联网产品是怎么做的？深度体验全新的Notion 3.0！
...
Notion 应该是传统互联网工具产品 AI 转型最成功的一个。
...
昨晚，他们更新了 Notion 3.0，现在的 Notion 可以看作一个你有所有上下文的通用 Agent 产品，而且你可以在这里用所有顶尖模型完成任务。

我早上研究了一下，发现这玩意相当强大，所以顺便写一篇内容介绍一下现在的 Notion AI 能力。

首先是基础的 AI 能力，你可以在Notion左侧的 Notion AI 看到一个跟其他 AI 产品差不多的页面。

支持选择所有现在的顶尖模型，比如 GPT-5 或者 Claude 4.1。

同时核心是你可以添加任意的上下文，上传文件也行，选择你的 Notion 指定数据库也可以，还能添加多个 Notion 数据库。

如果你觉得上面给 AI 的上下文还不够的话你还可以选择通过 Notion 链接很多其他软件获取上下文，比如海外常用的 Gmail、开发协作的 Github 和 Linear 等。

比如我这里就可以选择我周刊的数据库让他查找对应信息。

当然除了在这个页面，你也可以在任何页面右下角的图标拉起 Notion AI，他会直接在上下文这里引用当前的数据库或者页面。

而且现在的 Notion AI 不止可以回答问题和写作，也可以帮你生成和修改你需要的数据库表格格式，比如我这里查询了一下未打款内容，他在查完之后还问我要不要帮我创建一个逾期的视图。

然后我就试了一次这个数据库创建和修改的能力，我这里每月任务数量这个图表我一直不知道该怎么设置。

我想要看每个月的任务数量，但我自己只能创建 Y 轴是任务进度分类，然后按月份分组，很不直观。

于是就让他改了一下，这个页面有多个图表，他居然知道我说的是哪个，而且顺利 Get 了我的意思帮我创建了对应的条形图。

在每个页面输入斜杠命令里面也会有跟写作和记录的 AI 功能，首先就是新增的 AI 速记。

这个能力可以帮你实时转录和总结当前会议内容，如果你需要写相关的会议记录的话，简直太好用了，会议录音和转录都在这里文件里，你只需要补充其他素材和适当润色就行。

另一个页面的 AI 能力是 AI 区块，你可以自定义这个区块的 AI 提示词。

比如总结页面内容或者分析页面的某些数据或者 @ 某些人，这样其他协作者也可以直接看到这部分内容是 AI 生成的或者修改 AI 区块的提示词生成自己需要的内容。

另一个在页面写作的时候启用 AI 内容的方式是直接在新一行的开头按空格，这时候就会有一系列预制的 AI 能力。

比如总结、生成 Todo 或者制作表格和流程图等，交互非常自然。

那你说如果我想要让 AI 帮我改某部分内容该怎么办，你直接选中这部分内容，就有润色文案和问 AI ，这时候你就能让 AI 帮你处理这段话了。

上面这些都是 Notion AI 的基础应用，我们再来看一下昨晚 Notion 3.0 的主要升级，Agent 创建。

无论是在页面下方的图标或者是 AI 页面，在 AI 形象的头像旁边你都可以看到这个自定义 AI 的图标。

点击之后你就能设置自己的 Notion Agent 了，首先他会问你这个 Agent 的名字。

你还可以给这个 Agent 增加图标配饰来区别每个 Agent，有意思的是这个配饰是直接增加在 Notion AI 图标上的，这样既保持了 AI 能力形象的一致性，又增加了区分度，不愧是设计师出生的 CEO。

然后你就可以点击 Instructions 这个按钮自定义你的 Agent 了，点进去你会发现这个 Agent 是一个页面，是不是想到了什么。

对的这个类似 Claude Code 的斜杠命令，每个 Agent 的提示词都是一个页面，页面可以添加数据库表格甚至可以@ 对应的用户，极大的拓展了提示词的能力，同时又易于理解。

比如这个Agent 示例，你就可以定义 Agent 身份、聊天互动的语气和交流方式以及最重要的上下文。

将 Agent 提示词变成页面还有一个好处就行，你可以把你的 Agent 模板发布到 Notion 的市场上赚钱，你积攒的提示词变现渠道又多了一个。

我们点击上面的浏览模板就可以去到 Agent 模板市场，可以看到现在已经有了很多官方和创作者制作的模板上线了。

比如这个 Agent 模板就是帮你规范 AI 的输出结果，让他基于你服务的客户和你的服务本身生成文案和思考方案。

除了这个个人 Agent 之外，Notion 还发布了一个 Custom Agent 能力，这个主要增加的能力就是可以让多个 Agent 实现相互嵌套和协作，同时增加了触发器和自动化能力。

比如你完全可以让他在周三的周会前总结所有...

# How to use Notion AI for Faster Content Creation

Notion AI is one of the most popular productivity apps out there. Everyone uses the app for project management, note-taking, knowledge organization, or as a digital workspace. But it can also be used as an AI tool, since it includes an AI feature similar to LLMs like ChatGPT or Google Gemini. As a result, one can use it for content creation, and that’s what we are going to talk about in this post.

## How to use Notion AI for Faster Content Creation

Notion AI’s built-in assistant tool can help you write, find answers, and work with your pages and databases. And since one of its key features is writing, you can use it for generating blog posts, social media content, essays, YouTube scripts, and more. And here’s your step-by-step guide to exactly that:

#### 1] Start a draft

Start by creating a new page or using an existing one, then click the Ask AI button at the bottom. Once you click on it, you will encounter several options such as Draft anything, Draft an outline, and more. Since we want to generate content, click on Draft anything.

#### 2] Type your prompt

Now, just like any other LLMs, you need to write a prompt, which is basically describing what you wish to write. For instance, if you run a travel blog and want to talk about the places to visit in Europe, then you can simply tell the AI to write a blog post about the best places to visit in Europe, and it will start generating the content for you.

For example:

Create a reusable template that includes reusable sections such as

- Title
- Target keyword
- Search intent
- Outline
- Draft
- Internal links
- Meta description

Once done, you can trigger Notion AI inside each section using prompts such as “Write a blog intro in a conversational tone for US audience.”

#### 3] Use AI inline to rewrite what you already have

There is a pretty good chance that the content generated by AI needs to be rewritten or revised. And you can make all the changes using the AI inline feature. You can highlight a specific paragraph, section, or the entire content, then click Ask AI to make changes such as fixing grammar, shortening or expanding the content, or changing the tone.

You can also click the Improve writing button to generate an improved version of the content. But you cannot add your own instructions.

#### 4] Repurpose content instantly

Convert Blog Posts into social media content by using prompts such as these:

- Turn this into a LinkedIn post
- Convert this into a Reddit post with a natural tone
- Create 5 tweet ideas from this

#### 5] Give AI more context with @mentions

You can also use the @mention feature to attach another page, so the AI can get more context about what you wish to write. This is particularly useful when you want to create a report on existing data you have stored in Notion, summarize your knowledge base and more.

So those were a few quick steps to start using Notion AI for faster content creation. If you have already used an LLM tool before, Notion AI wouldn’t feel strange. You just need to learn the little features it has, which are no-brainers.

notion ai需主动触发，支持/命令、空格菜单、新建页面、文本选中四种唤醒方式；可生成新内容、编辑优化文本、批量处理数据库字段，并通过ai智能体实现自动化响应。

## 一、启动Notion AI的多种触发方式

如果您已登录Notion并希望立即调用AI功能，需通过特定交互动作唤醒AI编辑器。Notion AI不自动弹出，必须主动触发。不同场景下存在多种等效入口，适用于网页版、桌面版及移动端（部分功能在移动App中受限）。

1、在任意空白页面中，将光标置于新段落开头，直接输入斜杠 “/”，随后在下拉菜单中选择“Ask AI”或任一AI指令项（如“Brainstorm ideas”）。

2、在任意段落中按下空格键（Space），弹出快捷菜单后点击“Draft with AI”，再选择内容类型（如Blog post、To-do list）。

3、新建页面时，在创建弹窗中点击“Start writing with AI”按钮，从预设模板（Outline、Social media post等）中选择并输入提示词。

4、在已有文本上选中一段内容，点击顶部工具栏出现的“Ask AI”图标，进入编辑模式，可执行“改进写作”“修复拼写和语法”等操作。

## 二、使用AI生成新内容的完整流程

Notion AI支持基于提示词（prompt）即时生成结构化文本，无需切换外部工具。生成结果直接嵌入当前页面，保留原有块格式与样式继承关系，便于后续手动调整。

1、在页面中新建一个空白块，输入/brainstorm并回车，进入头脑风暴模式。

2、在提示框中输入具体需求，例如：“列出5个关于远程团队协作效率提升的可行方案”。

3、按回车确认，AI将在下方生成带编号的列表块；若结果不理想，点击“Try again”重新生成。

4、生成完成后，点击“Done”锁定内容，或点击“Continue writing”追加后续段落。
...
## 五、配置AI智能体（Notion Agent）实现自动化响应

Notion 3.0引入的智能体（Agent）具备记忆能力与工作区上下文感知，可设定长期角色与行为规则，替代重复性指令输入，适用于固定流程任务（如日报生成、周报汇总、任务状态同步）。

1、进入工作区设置页，点击左侧导航栏的“AI Agents”，再点击“+ New agent”。

2、为智能体命名（如“项目日报助手”），上传头像，并在“Instructions”框中明确描述其职责，例如：“你负责每周五下午3点自动生成本周任务完成情况摘要，引用‘Projects’数据库中Status为‘Done’且Date Last Updated在7天内的条目”。

3、启用“Remember preferences”选项，确保其记住常用格式（如偏好Markdown列表、拒绝使用emoji）。

4、保存后，在任意页面输入@项目日报助手并发送指令，即可触发其按预设逻辑执行任务。
